mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER
ORDER BY TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO DESC, UPDATE_TIME DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{pageNumber}
OFFSET #{pageNumber} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROLLED_ENTERPRISE_ID = #{controlledEnterpriseId} AND CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO DESC
SELECT * FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROLLER_ENTERPRISE_ID = #{controllerEnterpriseId} AND CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO DESC
SELECT * FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROLLED_ENTERPRISE_ID = #{controlledEnterpriseId} AND IS_ULTIMATE_CONTROLLER = 1 AND CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO DESC
SELECT * FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROLLED_ENTERPRISE_ID = #{controlledEnterpriseId} AND IS_CONCERTED_ACTION = 1 AND CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO DESC
SELECT * FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROLLER_TYPE = #{controllerType} AND CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO DESC
SELECT * FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROLLER_NATURE = #{controllerNature} AND CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO DESC
SELECT * FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROL_METHOD = #{controlMethod} AND CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO DESC
SELECT * FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROL_RISK_LEVEL = #{controlRiskLevel} AND CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO DESC
SELECT * FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE NEED_SPECIAL_SUPERVISION = #{needSpecialSupervision} AND CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY CONTROL_RISK_LEVEL DESC, TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO DESC
SELECT * FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE REGULATORY_ATTENTION = #{regulatoryAttention} AND CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO DESC
SELECT * FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROL_PATH LIKE CONCAT('%', #{startEnterpriseId}, '%', #{endEnterpriseId}, '%') AND CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY CONTROL_LEVEL

select.if: WITH RECURSIVE control_tree AS ( SELECT *, 1 as level FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROLLER_ENTERPRISE_ID = #{controllerEnterpriseId} AND CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT ac.*, ct.level + 1 FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER ac INNER JOIN control_tree ct ON ac.CONTROLLER_ENTERPRISE_ID = ct.CONTROLLED_ENTERPRISE_ID WHERE ct.level < #{maxLevel} AND ac.CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ) SELECT * FROM control_tree ORDER BY level, TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO DESC
SELECT * FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROLLER_ENTERPRISE_ID = #{controllerEnterpriseId} AND CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY CONTROL_LEVEL, TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO DESC

mapper.select: SELECT CONTROLLER_TYPE as controllerType, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(DISTINCT CONTROLLED_ENTERPRISE_ID) as controlledEnterprises, AVG(TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO) as avgShareholdingRatio FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY CONTROLLER_TYPE ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CONTROLLER_NATURE as controllerNature, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(DISTINCT CONTROLLED_ENTERPRISE_ID) as controlledEnterprises, AVG(TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO) as avgShareholdingRatio FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY CONTROLLER_NATURE ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CONTROL_METHOD as controlMethod, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(DISTINCT CONTROLLED_ENTERPRISE_ID) as controlledEnterprises, AVG(TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO) as avgShareholdingRatio FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY CONTROL_METHOD ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CONTROL_STATUS as controlStatus, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER), 2) as percentage FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER GROUP BY CONTROL_STATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CONTROL_STABILITY as controlStability, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'), 2) as percentage FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY CONTROL_STABILITY ORDER BY CASE CONTROL_STABILITY WHEN 'STABLE' THEN 1 WHEN 'UNSTABLE' THEN 2 WHEN 'VOLATILE' THEN 3 WHEN 'UNCERTAIN' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT CONTROL_RISK_LEVEL as controlRiskLevel, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'), 2) as percentage FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY CONTROL_RISK_LEVEL ORDER BY CASE CONTROL_RISK_LEVEL WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT REGULATORY_ATTENTION as regulatoryAttention, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'), 2) as percentage FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY REGULATORY_ATTENTION ORDER BY CASE REGULATORY_ATTENTION WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(CONTROL_START_DATE, '%Y-%m') as period,
TO_CHAR(CONTROL_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') as period,
COUNT(*) as newControlRelations, COUNT(DISTINCT CONTROLLED_ENTERPRISE_ID) as affectedEnterprises, AVG(TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO) as avgShareholdingRatio FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROL_START_DATE IS NOT NULL
AND CONTROL_START_DATE >= #{startDate}
AND CONTROL_START_DATE <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY
DATE_FORMAT(CONTROL_START_DATE, '%Y-%m')
TO_CHAR(CONTROL_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY period

SELECT CONTROLLED_ENTERPRISE_ID as enterpriseId, CONTROLLED_ENTERPRISE_NAME as enterpriseName, COUNT(*) as controllerCount, MAX(TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO) as maxShareholdingRatio, SUM(TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO) as totalShareholdingRatio, COUNT(CASE WHEN IS_ULTIMATE_CONTROLLER = 1 THEN 1 END) as ultimateControllerCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN IS_CONCERTED_ACTION = 1 THEN 1 END) as concertedActionCount FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER WHERE CONTROL_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY CONTROLLED_ENTERPRISE_ID, CONTROLLED_ENTERPRISE_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY controllerCount DESC, totalShareholdingRatio DESC

SELECT CONTROLLER_ID as controllerId, CONTROLLED_ENTERPRISE_NAME as controlledEnterpriseName, CONTROLLER_ENTERPRISE_NAME as controllerEnterpriseName, CONTROLLER_TYPE as controllerType, CONTROLLER_NATURE as controllerNature, CONTROL_METHOD as controlMethod, CONTROL_STATUS as controlStatus, TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO as totalShareholdingRatio, VOTING_RIGHT_RATIO as votingRightRatio, IS_ULTIMATE_CONTROLLER as isUltimateController, IS_CONCERTED_ACTION as isConcertedAction, CONTROL_STABILITY as controlStability, CONTROL_RISK_LEVEL as controlRiskLevel, REGULATORY_ATTENTION as regulatoryAttention, CONFIRMATION_STATUS as confirmationStatus FROM ACTUAL_CONTROLLER
ORDER BY TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO DESC
